name: Speed Test
description: Measure upload and download speed to SG/Send infrastructure. Sim mode runs an offline AES-256-GCM crypto benchmark. Live mode measures real network throughput using ChunkedUploader and ChunkedDownloader.

actions.name: runAll
actions.description: Run the full test sequence for the current mode (sim: encrypt+decrypt; live: upload+download).

actions.name: runSim
actions.description: Run the crypto benchmark in isolation. Returns a SimResult.

actions.name: runUpload
actions.description: Run a live upload test using ChunkedUploader. Requires sendUrl and accessToken.

params.name: opts
params.type: { sendUrl?, accessToken?, sizeBytes?, chunkSize?, maxConcurrent?, onProgress? }

actions.name: runDownload
actions.description: Run a live download test against a URL using ChunkedDownloader.

actions.name: setTarget
actions.description: Set the SG/Send base URL (live mode).

actions.name: setAccessToken
actions.description: Set the access token for live upload (value is not logged).

actions.name: setDownloadUrl
actions.description: Set the download URL for live download test.

actions.name: getLastResult
actions.description: Return the most recent test result, or null.

actions.name: getHistory
actions.description: Return the last 10 test results with timestamps.
actions.returns: Array<{ ts: number, result: SimResult | LiveResult }>

events.name: tool:ready
events.description: Fired when SgToolApi.activate() completes and window.__tool is live.

events.name: tool:connected
events.description: Not used by speed-test (no credential connection step).
